title: The Ainul
subtitle: Witnesses beyond the veil
description: The Ainul are not gods, though mortals often kneel before their passing. They are the witnesses who survived the world before language, bound to observe each turning of the Seven Thrones without direct dominion.

sections.title: The Choir Beyond
sections.body: Ainul communicate through shared recollection rather than speech. To hear their choir is to remember lives never lived.

sections.title: The Covenant of Glass
sections.body: After the Sundering, the Ainul swore never again to hold a throne. Their emissaries may counsel a keeper, but each counsel exacts a memory.
